scope: from-scratch docker build + boot against a freshly created database; not a fresh git clone

steps.name: tear down any existing compose stack (including volumes)
start a brand-new Postgres (no prior data)
wait for Postgres to accept connections
apply migrations to the fresh database
run the freshly built image against the fresh database
smoke test: log in as the seeded admin and list tasks
tear down the rehearsal container (compose db is left running)
